text:
leah: Opening a tiny PR to refresh the Quickstart flow. Objectives: simplify auth wording, add a one-line curl smoke test, show a tiny serverless (Vercel) example using an ephemeral token, and update a single SDK snippet to the v8 Client. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5610 (WIP).
tom: Split the SDK change into its own commit so reviewers can focus.
anya: Please add a quick curl example under 'Test locally' — saves so many support pings.
leah: Curl I'll add like:
```
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"hello from curl"}'
```
tom: Also include a Docker tip: EXPOSE 3000 in the sample Dockerfile and run with `-e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY -p 3000:3000`.
anya: Add a one-liner recommending pinning model versions e.g. `model: "redwood/gpt-small:2025-01-01"` to avoid silent regressions.
leah: Done. Also added local smoke steps: `npm ci && npm run start` then run the curl. Note about clearing KV cache if samples look stale.
deploy-bot: preview build queued for PR 5610 (ETA ~6m).
leah: Fixed the broken deploy link to /docs/deploy/quickstart and used REDWOOD_API_KEY everywhere. Waiting for preview then will merge small docs changes if green.
deploy-bot: preview for PR 5610 finished (status: success) - https://deploy-preview-5610--docs.redwood.ai
tom: I'll take the SDK commit review after lunch. If green, open follow-up to migrate other snippets.
leah: Created follow-up issue docs#256 to migrate remaining snippets to client v8 next sprint. Thanks all, merging after CI. Closing thread.
